hypotheses.claim: For strict prefix-causal online bin packing, scoring open bins by smallest feasible residual (Best Fit, score ~ capacity-(rem_item)) instead of the current worst-fit opposite preference reduces total bin count on cvrp_dev_hetero_24 (obp dev_36), since tighter fills preserve large residual bins for later items; the gain should grow with instance size (50 -> 200 items), where the archive shows the largest relative gaps.

next_search_advice.direction: Replace worst-fit preference in score_bin with best-fit (tightest feasible residual) plus a residual-slack tie-break against opening a new bin.
